tasks.step: Diagnose: identify TLS probe root cause from logs
tasks.notes: Root cause: UpgradeScheme maps media xAddr to HTTPS port 443; Milesight returns HTTP 400 on /onvif/Media and /onvif/media2 at port 443. withMedia1/2HttpFallback did not catch 4xx errors (only ConnectionRefused). After adding IsHttps4xxFromCamera guard, fallback fires correctly — but WCF HTTP transport then returns ProtocolException 400 from the HTTP media endpoint.

Two fixes: (1) NvtSession.fs: added IsHttps4xxFromCamera static member; extended withMedia1HttpFallback and withMedia2HttpFallback to retry on HTTP 4xx from HTTPS URLs. (2) NvtSession.fs: pre-configure ServicePoint.Expect100Continue=false in GetMediaClient, GetMedia2Client, createMediaClientAt, createMedia2ClientAt to stop WCF HTTP transport sending Expect: 100-Continue to Milesight (which returns 400). 97/97 unit tests pass. Integration test results pending camera run.
